## Pre-preview intake gate

- [ ] This is not a security vulnerability, conduct report, credential issue, or private-data report.
- [ ] I understand that AstraBridge has no public support commitment or maintainer-response SLA until public intake is explicitly enabled.
- [ ] I used a no-key or other explicitly authorized reproduction route.

## What were you trying to understand or improve?

Describe one bounded user goal and why it matters to a developer evaluating the product.

## Evidence or reproduction

Provide source commit/version, operating system, exact non-sensitive steps, expected result, actual result, and redacted diagnostics if available.

## Suggested routing

Choose the closest area: `documentation`, `task-graph`, `desktop`, `runtime`, `provider-metadata`, `extensions`, `release`, or `public-claim`.

## Maintainer disposition after public intake is enabled

The future owner should record one of: `acknowledged`, `needs-info`, `accepted-for-design`, `declined`, or `blocked`. This template does not itself activate public intake.
